key_insight: The paper proposes stochastic first- and zeroth-order optimization methods for training on a mix of ground-truth and potentially incorrect ML-generated labels.
engineering_relevance: These methods address settings where human labeling is costly and ML-generated labels expand the available training data.
method: Combine ground-truth-labeled samples with samples labeled by an ML predictor.
Develop stochastic first-order optimization for mixed-label training.
Develop stochastic zeroth-order optimization for the same setting.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports empirical studies spanning linear regression training to LLM fine-tuning, but provides no quantitative results.
watch_item: Robustness to different rates and patterns of ML-label errors should be checked before deployment.
paper_title: Training with ML-labeled Data via Stochastic First- and Zeroth-Order Optimization
